{{Quote|Oh, hey! You aren't a Meatlump. I don't want to be a Meatlump. We have so much in common.|Pech Seki, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MQ" />}}
'''Pech Seki''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]], a group of technology-hating thugs based on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I left my bag and strongbox in the cave, though. Will you go get them for me? I can't go any further inside.|Pech Seki, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MQ" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Seki lived in the [[Meatlump Cave]] near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] and participated in the gang's activities against the use of technology on the planet. But Seki wanted to quit being a Meatlump.<ref name="SWG:MQ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he was ready to leave the cave and the Meatlumps behind, but he had left his bag and his strongbox behind in the cave.<ref name="SWG:MQ" /> Luckily, he met an adventurer that worked for the [[Corellian Security Force]] as an independent agent. The adventurer investigated the attack on the [[Captain/Legends#Civilian use|starship captain]] [[Osto Grissom]] and planned to disrupt the Meatlumps' vandalisms.<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery|Corellia}}</ref> The agent agreed to help Seki and a short time later, he got his belongings back and could finally leave the life as a Meatlump behind.<ref name="SWG:MQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pech Seki was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:MQ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Pech Seki was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> He could be found right inside the Meatlump Cave near Tyrena on Corellia. During the quest "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery|CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery]]" — which was a part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest]], the longest quest line of the game — the player entered the cave to kill several Meatlumps and destroy their supplies. Seki offered a small side quest that could be completed by finding his bag and strongbox inside of the cave. The reward for this mission was app. 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWG:MQ" />
